name: The Starlight Piano Staircase
description: A grand piano staircase made of crystallized starlight where each step plays a different musical note, leading to a observatory dome filled with swirling constellations.
prompt: An elegant staircase crafted from crystallized starlight ascending towards a magnificent glass observatory dome. Each marble-like step glows with different constellation patterns and emits a soft musical chime when stepped upon. The railing is formed from twisted comet tails that shimmer with stardust. At the top, the observatory reveals a rotating celestial sphere filled with recognizable constellations connected by beams of pure light. Midnight blue and silver palette, ethereal glow, architectural fantasy.
caption: Take the stairs - each step composes a symphony written in starlight... 🎹🌟
